correctness.rationale: From the exact vector field, Rdot=2R(z−beta), so stationary antiderivative tests on compact support with R bounded away from zero yield E[z|R]=beta; z-test primitives yield E[(1+rho*z)R|z]=G(z). Their orthogonal decompositions give Var(z)=E[(Rdot/R)^2]/4 and Var((1+rho*z)R)=Var(G(z))+E[zdot^2]. Under 1+rho*beta !=0 and G(beta)/(1+rho*beta)>0 the zero-variance support is exactly the rotating circle. Checked exact parameter specialization R*=3557/3525. A polynomial/rational checker does not prove stationary conditional quantifiers, which follow analytically.
